newsitem.title: USA: First Brands chooses new chairman.
newsitem.headline: First Brands chooses new chairman.

text.p: First Brands Corp said Friday William Stephenson had been elected chairman.
He succeeds Alfred Dudley, who will be retiring from the chairmanship at the end of the year, a statement from the company said.
Stephenson, 55, adds his new title and responsibilities to his current position as president and chief executive of the company, the statement said.
Stephenson's career with the company spans 32 years and includes key executive positions within the company's automotive and home products businesses, the statement said.
He has been CEO since 1994, the statement said.
Dudley will remain a member of the board, and chairman of the executive committee, the statement said.
